answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA deposit for a 30-day horizon before it can earn: the deposit is a bridge between identity and accountability, since a Sybil farm must fund each fake separately and loses the whole stake if any of its identities is caught double-signing. Newcomers start throttled to one attestation per day until three established peers vouch for them, so creating a thousand fakes costs 500,000 POA locked for a month plus real vouches — far more than the nectar of short-term mining rewards they could extract.
